title: Slide a filter by hand, then count the weights
brief: Write the one-channel sliding filter, grow it into a batched multi-channel convolution with loops, and count the weights of dense, convolutional, and depthwise separable layers.
hints: conv2d_single: for each output position (i, j), multiply the k by k patch x[i:i + k, j:j + k] by w entry by entry, sum, and add b. The kernel is not flipped.
conv2d_naive: pad first with np.pad, then loop over image, output channel, row, and column. For each position, sum w[o] * patch over all input channels and kernel cells, then add b[o].

param_counts: dense is n_in * n_out + n_out. A convolution is c_out * c_in * k * k + c_out. A depthwise separable layer is c_in * k * k for the per-channel filters, plus c_in * c_out for the 1 by 1 mix, plus c_out biases.
